Name: Larger Scythe Hitbox
Author: OArtu5
Description:
[b]What this mod does[/b]
Larger Scythe Hitbox expands the actual in-game cutting area of the Scythe and Golden Scythe.

[b]This mod is made for players who want:[/b]
- faster farm cleanup,
- easier cutting of grass, weeds, and other scythe targets,
- support for both vanilla scythes,
- simple in-game configuration through Generic Mod Config Menu,
- an enable/disable toggle,
- and the option to push the scythe range to very large values up to 8000.

[b]Important:[/b]
The white slash animation stays vanilla.
This mod changes the real cutting area, not the visual swing effect.

[b]Features[/b]
- Supports the Scythe and Golden Scythe.
- Configurable hitbox values directly in GMCM.
- Includes an enable/disable toggle.
- Supports editable numeric values up to 8000.
- Designed for players who want anything from a small quality-of-life buff to a hilariously oversized scythe range.

[b]Installation[/b]
1. Download the mod.
2. Extract the LargerScytheHitbox folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. If you use GMCM, open the in-game config menu and adjust:
  - Enable Mod
  - Scythe Area
  - Golden Scythe Area

[b]Requirements[/b]
- SMAPI
- Generic Mod Config Menu
